verdict.meets_ask: Yes, with a taste caveat. Eight SVGs exist under icons/ with the requested names, 24x24 viewBox, only <path> elements, fill=none, stroke=currentColor, no ids/filters/opacity, 462-621 bytes each (limit 1,500). preview/index.html shows all eight, labelled, at 24 and 48 px on light and dark panels, inlined byte-identically, opens from file:// with no other request, and reflows at 375 px; it also has an unlabelled shuffled 24 px grid. The look is a consistent loose single-weight pen line (looped sun, lumpy cloud, uneven drops, bowed tide posts): clearly not geometric icon-pack, reads as hand-drawn and legible at 24 px. It reads more 'neat sketchbook doodle' than scratchy dip-pen ink, which is the honest limit of constant-width strokes that the design called out.
